chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyas ibn Ibrahim, from Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) did not perform Hajj after his arrival in Medina except for one, and he had performed Hajj in Mecca with his people, (multiple) Hajjs.
ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet perform Hajj after migrating to Medina?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi establishes the scholarly consensus that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) performed only one obligatory Hajj after his migration to Medina, often identified as the Farewell Hajj. It distinguishes this singular post-migration act from the multiple voluntary or minor pilgrims (Hajjat) he undertook in Mecca prior to the Hijra, highlighting the transition in his ritual practice following the establishment of the Islamic community.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Giyas Bin Ibrahim, 
(It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> did not perform Hajj, after proceeding to Al-Medina, except for one, and he<sup>saww</sup> had performed Hajj in Makkah along with his<sup>saww</sup> people, (many) Hajjs’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

The Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, performed only one hajj from al- Madinah; however, he had performed al-Hajj many times when in Makkah along with his people.’”
